method.rule: Each A-G requirement is linked to the exact knowledge source, raw probe/reuse evidence, and current-package live evidence where available. A missing link remains NOT_PROVEN; historical PASS is not transferred to 20260913e.

classification_contract.required_evidence_gap: A required stage is missing; it cannot be marked complete from a related probe or normalized comparison.
classification_contract.optional_unconfirmed: An explicit boundary outside the minimum A-G requirement; it must not block the required decision.
classification_contract.external_blocked: A required stage is blocked by an unavailable live UI or bridge; it remains open and is not reclassified as optional.

t04_new_pair.summary: New independent T04 pair accepted separately; old primary failure/candidate_partial/Run1 NOT_CAPTURED preserved. Required acceptance for normal M365 Copilot Chat + PAD 20260913e is technically satisfied under the explicit 2026-09-15 user completion contract. T10 functional execution, requested changes only, and unchanged command/content preservation PASS; transport raw-byte preservation remains NOT_PROVEN (non-blocking limitation), outside raw bytes FAIL, requests/completed/remaining 1/1/0 for each response. Prior T04 failures and partial observations remain history. Close only after fresh checks and main integration.

t10_strict_boundary_audit.reason: Historical strict boundary audit: NOT_PROVEN and outside bytes FAIL unchanged. Under the explicit 2026-09-15 user decision this transport limitation is non-blocking; see current_acceptance.

historical_pre_content_decision.t04_new_pair.summary: Independent T04 new pair 20260914w passed both per-run CSV/xlsx snapshots and fixed 3x3 values; Run1 verified before Run2. Old candidate and old Run1 NOT_CAPTURED remain historical. Original primary T04 remains not accepted and is not double-counted. Required remaining: T10 strict raw-byte preservation NOT_PROVEN. Issues remain OPEN / partial. Paste-observer failure required native clipboard history restoration; text equality and original formats were verified, full-format byte equality was not assessed.
historical_pre_content_decision.t10_strict_boundary_audit.reason: Historical Add File saving appends LF in one same-operation synthetic control. Browser inventory timed out; no real recapture. Existing real candidates fail outside the exact two literal-content intervals. C and independent T04 new pair remain accepted; only strict T10 remains required.
